why_not: The question lives only while the sheet is open; nothing saved carries over an update
The question is asked on the device where the sale is typed; no other device takes part
The question shows only the amounts and day the person just typed; it stores nothing of its own

note: A plan listed at ₹0: any price above zero raises the question
The far-start count ('<n> days from today') changes at midnight, so the text differs and the question is asked again
A fast double tap on Confirm is the same as asking and answering yes: the second tap lands on Yes, save
The sheet words are plain text in the code, not passed through the translate helper used on the member page; whether another language reaches them was not checked
The banner appears at the top of a long sheet while the button is at the bottom: on a phone the question may be off screen
